Über Zenjob
Zenjob ist eine AI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personalbesetzung. Wir verbinden Unternehmen mit kurzfristigen Arbeitskräften, schnell, zuverlässig und datenbasiert. Mehr als 5.000 Unternehmen arbeiten mit uns. Wir wachsen profitabel und sind an einem Wendepunkt: von der Buchungsplattform zum strategischen Workforce-Partner.
Was dich erwartet
Du übernimmst ein Portfolio bestehender Kunden und trägst die volle Verantwortung für die Kundenbeziehung und das Wachstum im Bestand dieses Kunden.
Du berätst Unternehmen zu ihrer Personalstrategie. Das bedeutet: Du entwickelst individuelle Staffing-Konzepte, bist täglich nah am Kunden und vertrittst deren Interessen intern bei Zenjob. Du bist die Verbindung zwischen dem, was der Markt und Kunden braucht, und dem, was wir als Unternehmen liefern.
Zenjob wächst und baut gerade die kommerzielle Organisation um. Von einem regionalen Modell in vier spezialisierte Verticals. Werde Teil der “Customer first” Zukunft bei Zenjob.
Was du tust
Portfolio-Steuerung: Du steuert dein Portfolio wie ein Unternehmen und bist täglich im Austausch mit deinen Kunden zu ihrer Personalstrategie und - planung. Du weißt, welche Standorte wachsen, welche Kapazitäten geplant sind und wo Wachstumspotenzial liegt.
Analyse & Priorisierung: Du analysierst und steuerst dein Portfolio: Wachstumspotenziale, Buchungsvolumen, Besetzungsquoten und Umsatzentwicklung pro Account und Standort. Daraus leitest du ab, welche Accounts Priorität haben, um Wachstumspotenziale zu realisieren.
Konzeptentwicklung: Du entwickelst individuelle Konzepte. Wenn ein Lebensmitteleinzelhändler in der Vorweihnachtszeit 40 zusätzliche Schichten pro Woche braucht, erarbeitest du gemeinsam mit dem Kunden, wie das strukturiert abgedeckt werden kann: Jobprofile, Vorlaufzeiten, Standortverteilung. Das Konzept kommt von dir, nicht vom Kunden.
Wachstum im Bestand: Du identifizierst Wachstumsmöglichkeiten im Bestand: neue Standorte desselben Kunden anbinden, Einsatzbereiche ausweiten, saisonale Bedarfe frühzeitig strukturieren. Du sprichst diese Potenziale aktiv an und erarbeitest einen konkreten Plan zur Umsetzung.
Preisverhandlung: Du verhandelst Preise und Konditionen mit deinen Kunden — auf Augenhöhe und mit klarer Marge im Blick. Verhandlung ist Teil deines Alltags, nicht eine Ausnahme.
“Voice of the customer”: Du vertrittst die Interessen deiner Kunden intern bei Zenjob. Wenn ein Account operative Probleme hat, schlechte Besetzungsquoten, Qualitätsprobleme, zu lange Reaktionszeiten, bringst du das mit konkretem Kontext ins Operations-Team und treibst die Lösung voran. Du bist DIE Stimme des Kunden bei Zenjob
Marktinformationen teilen: Du gibst Marktinformationen aus deinen Kundengesprächen proaktiv und strukturiert weiter, an Marketing, Product und Operations. Wenn mehrere Kunden dasselbe Problem nennen oder ein Wettbewerber ein neues Angebot macht, landet das konsolidiert bei den richtigen Stakeholdern.
Reaktivierung: Du reaktivierst inaktive Accounts systematisch. Du weißt, welche Kunden in deinem Portfolio nicht mehr buchen, kennst den Grund und hast einen konkreten Plan zur Reaktivierung.
Business Reviews: Du führst strukturierte Business Reviews: Entwicklung des Buchungsvolumens, Fulfillment-Performance, Planung für das nächste Quartal, mit Daten, klarer Einschätzung und vereinbarten Maßnahmen.
Coaching: Du bist Sparringspartner für Junior & Midlevel AMs bei schwierigen Kundengesprächen, Wachstumskonzepten oder Präsentationen und gibst direkte Rückmeldung zu Gesprächsführung und Konzeptqualität.

About SINGU
At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.
Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.
Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.
If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.
The Opportunity
This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.
The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.
Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.
Why Strong Sellers Join Singu
A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.
Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.
Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.
Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.
Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.
Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.
What You Will Own
Pipeline and Coverage
A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.
Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.
Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.
Deal Execution
Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.
Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.
Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.
Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.
Land and Expand
First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.
A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.
Forecasting and Governance
A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.
Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.
Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.
What Excellent Performance Looks Like
Commercial outcomes
New-logo ARR against quota
Pipeline creation and territory coverage
Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision
Average deal value and total multi-year value
Strategic logos won
Operating standards
Forecast accuracy and stage integrity
Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality
Price protection and discount discipline
CRM quality and process discipline
Your First 12 Months
First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.
By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.
By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.
Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.
The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.
English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.
A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.
Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.
CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.
Package, Support and Progression
Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.
Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success
Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.
Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a competitive, customer-obsessed Account Executive to help us become the fastest-growing agent security and governance platform in the world.
This is one of the first GTM sales roles at the company. You'll own your territory across Europe — sourcing pipeline, building channel relationships, qualifying accounts, and running tight Proof of Concept processes. You'll close deals that matter and help define what great GTM looks like at Geordie.
You won't have a full SDR team handing you leads. You'll prospect, cold call, and build pipeline yourself. You'll learn our product deeply enough to demo it flawlessly and hold your own in technical conversations. And you'll do all of this while helping us build the GTM function from the ground up — coaching others, sharing what works, and raising the bar for the whole team.
Beyond quota, you'll be a key voice in shaping our product direction. We are deeply customer obsessed, and we expect you to be too — bringing insights from the field directly to our product team so we can continue building the best-in-class platform for enterprise AI governance.
We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not curious about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.
We want winners. People who are hungry, proactive, collaborative, and ready to bring their best every single day.

Pipeline Generation — Build, maintain, and continuously refine a prioritised list of high-value target prospects within your assigned territory. You own your pipeline. That means cold calling, outbound prospecting, and finding creative ways to get in front of the right people.
Channel Development — Identify, develop, and activate reseller and partner relationships across your territory to accelerate revenue.
Product Mastery & Value-Based Selling — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Run flawless demos tailored to each audience, and clearly articulate business and security outcomes to stakeholders from security engineers to CISOs and Heads of AI.
Drive Revenue — Lead discovery sessions, product demos, proof-of-concept engagements, and customer evaluations from first call to closed-won.
CRM Discipline — Keep Hubspot (or equivalent) meticulously up to date. Clean data, accurate stages, clear next steps. Your pipeline should be something anyone on the team can read and trust.
Customer Success — Own the relationship post-close. Our customers' success is your success. You'll ensure they're getting full value from Geordie and expanding over time.
Forecasting & Deal Management — Maintain a rigorous, accurate pipeline and deliver reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts with clear visibility into deal status, risks, and next steps.
Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to execute deals well and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
Build the Function — As one of our first AEs, you'll help shape the culture, processes, and playbooks that define Geordie's GTM motion in EMEA. That includes coaching peers, sharing learnings, and helping the people around you get better.

This role is not for everyone. We're looking for a specific kind of person — one who competes hard, earns trust fast, and knows how to move complex deals through enterprise buying cycles without losing momentum.
You compete to win — and your track record shows it. You don't just hit quota, you know exactly why you hit it and how to repeat it.
You're a builder. Early-stage means no perfect playbook, no full SDR support, no hand-holding. You create structure where there isn't any and find a way.
You prospect without being asked. Cold calls, creative outbound, referrals — you don't wait for leads to land in your lap.
You get technical. You invest the time to truly understand what you sell, and you can demo the product confidently and compellingly to any audience
You earn trust at every level. You can hold a technical conversation in the morning and present to an executive in the afternoon without losing credibility in either room.
You listen before you talk. Strong discovery is your foundation. You ask sharp questions, identify real pain, and connect it to outcomes — not features.
You keep a clean house. Your CRM is always current, your forecasts are reliable, and your deals have clear next steps. You treat pipeline data as a professional obligation, not an afterthought.
You make the people around you better. You share what's working, coach peers proactively, and invest in the team's success — not just your own number.
You're obsessed with your customers. Not just during the deal. You care whether they succeed, and it shows in how you show up post-close.
You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — including agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You're curious about the tools we build and the tools we use.
You thrive in ambiguity. You don't wait for perfect information — you make a call, move, and course correct.
